So we're finally here, eh...
终于来这里了啊……
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
Heathcliff looked out the rattling bus window with a dour expression.
希斯克利夫皱起眉头，看向嘎吱作响的车窗之外。

Though it wasn't raining, the world outside was grey and opaque like an overcast sky. Black, pungent clouds of smoke had long devoured the atmosphere.
尽管没有下雨，外面的世界也是阴云笼罩，黑色的烟霾完全遮蔽了天空。

So this is the kind of place Heathcliff used to roam...
过去的希斯克利夫是否也曾在这样的街道里徘徊呢。

The color remains grey this deep into the heart of the Backstreets. I recall with quite the certitude that the T Corp. I arrived at after my departure from S Corp. was sepia-hued.
此处仍浸染于灰色之中。令我回想起我从S公司逃亡后的定居地，那里遍染着棕褐之色。

This phenomenon can be explained by the fact that the technology used to drain our saturation is situated at the center of T Corp. It has been reported that such variations in hue may occur in areas further away from its sphere of influence.
这是由于色彩回收装置处于T公司的中心位置。有报告表明，即使距离影响范围较远，此类现象也可能会发生。

Ah, I understand. Then...
啊，我明白了。这样一来……

Two other Sinners immediately jumped in on the conversation to direct it away from whichever obscure subject Yi Sang and Faust were about to steer it into.
正当李箱和浮士德要开始谈论某个令人费解的话题时，另外两位罪人慌忙转移了话头。

OH! Right, I had something to ask you guys!
啊啊！对了，这么说来~

Ohh, yeah! Uh, m-me too.
啊啊，那个啊？

What? I-I mean yeah! That's, uh... oh, yeah. The buildings here look a little different from where Yi Sang used to live... so I'm just wondering if there's anything up with that.
嗯？嗯！那个……感觉李箱先生曾经生活的地方，和这里的建筑物看起来不太一样呢~

Exactly! That's exactly what I was about to ask.
没错！我想问的就是这个。

It's been a while since we started on this journey together. I was starting to grow more comfortable with the Sinners.
也许是因为我与他们已经共度了一段不短的时光吧。

Maybe that's why I found Gregor and Rodya's valiant effort to keep this conversation remotely comprehensible to most occupants of the bus... pretty amusing.
我觉得罗佳和格里高尔想方设法阻止话题偏移到晦涩难懂的概念上的场景，实在是非常有趣。

Ah, allow me to elaborate, then. To discuss this subject, we must first—
哦，那是因为……

And Yi Sang, unknowingly shooting down their effort by jumping into another complicated discussion, was another sight I'd become familiar with.
而李箱认真解释的样子，似乎也并未超出我想象的范畴。

While I was curious about the technology T Corp. uses to drain our color, and about the behind-the-scenes of T Corp.'s operations...
虽然我想更详细地了解色彩回收装置是什么，以及T公司的内情如何，但是……

... it wasn't something that could be answered now. I decided to table that discussion for later.
这些并不是只有现在才能获取的信息，所以还是后面再说吧。

Instead, I approached Heathcliff. He was sitting all by his lonesome, clearly in deep thought.
带着这样的想法，我走到了独自苦恼着的希斯克利夫身边。

... Hm? Ah, Clockhead.
……嗯？啊。钟表头。

<Still wracking your head about what to wear to Wuthering Heights?>
<你还在苦恼该穿什么衣服去呼啸山庄吗？>

What?! N-no. It's nothing like that.
什么？！才、才不是咧。

Heathcliff protested, jumping up from his seat. Looks like I hit the nail right on the head.
希斯克利夫好像被看穿了一样，急忙从座位上跳了起来。

Fine, I was. A little bit. But... I was mostly reminiscing.
好吧，倒也不是没考虑过……只是，我主要还是在回忆过去的一些事情。

Mm, I do remember hearing that Heathcliff used to live in the Backstreets.
嗯，想起来了，我听说希斯克利夫曾经在后巷里活跃过一段时间。

A part of some... Syndicate, if I recall correctly.
还听说他似乎曾经是某个帮派的成员。

Vergilius did say that we were going through the Backstreets instead of going straight to the T Corp. Nest for a reason. And that it was because of the company's orders.
上次，维吉里乌斯曾提到过……我们选择穿过后巷而不是直接前往T公司，是出于公司的指示。

<... Maybe there's something for us to do here? Heathcliff did spend some time in the T Corp. Backstreets, after all.>
<……那么，这次我们是要去希斯克利夫活跃过的后巷里做些什么吗？>

<Maybe we'll run into a Golden Bough here...?>
<说不定这里会有金枝……>

No chance. If the Golden Bough was as common as any other twig in some Backstreets, why'd we be doing any of this globetrotting waste of time?
没有那种事吧。如果它只是后巷里随处可见的烂树枝级别的东西，我们还会这么辛苦吗？

<T-true, I guess...>
<话、话是这么说……>

... Besides, Wuthering Heights is... quite the manor in more ways than one. You won't find it anywhere near some run-down Backstreets like this.
……毕竟，那座在各种意义上都非常了不起的宅邸，怎么可能会在这种后巷里呢？

There's a chasm of wealth between these poor alleyway sods and... them.
巷子里游荡的无赖们……和那些人之间的差距可大了去了。

After all, they've sent me an invitation. Quite obvious that we'll find our Golden Bough in that manor, innit? Or at least somewhere in the same Nest?
而他们邀请我就意味着，这次的金枝显然就在那座宅邸所属的巢里。对吧？

... Correct. We will eventually travel to T Corp.'s Nest.
……正是如此。我们最终将前往T公司的巢。

Heathcliff continued to speak in a low voice. The hubbub from outside the bus seemed to blend with his words, turning into a mass of murmurs. There was a sort of commotion outside...
希斯克利夫低沉的嘀咕声中，似乎还混杂着一些杂乱的噪音。

Before we talk about wherever our eventual destination is, we'll have to clear the road of some blockage.
况且……管他什么最终还是最初，我们要是想成事，总得除掉那帮碍事的混蛋。

Your intuition is half-right, Heathcliff.
你说对了一半。

Hmpfh?!
哈？！

Heathcliff, who was muttering to himself in an uncharacteristic daze, jolted awake.
判若两人般嘀咕着的希斯克利夫一下子惊讶地瞪大了眼睛，提高了音量。

Bloody hell... what's wrong with you and the vroom-vroom lass? Neither of you ever do anything with a proper forewarning.
啊，妈的……别招呼都不打就突然吓唬人啊，那个嘀嘀叭叭和你怎么都这样。

I simply did not see the necessity in warning you.
我不觉得有提前说明的必要。

Anyway, those outside the bus are our 'targets'.
总之，巴士外面的那些家伙，就是我们的“目标”。

<Targets...?>
<目标……？>

I believe that he means to say that they must be eliminated.
意为消灭对象吗。

I feel compelled to let you know that that is not the only implication of the word 'target'. Though I am yet to be informed of the precise details of this mission, that is...
不只是这个意思。我也没有准确的信息，但是……

Regardless, you are to make contact with a 'target' among them.
不论如何，你们将在他们当中与目标接触。

Find the target, then extract the necessary intel. Is this clear enough for you, manager?
找到目标，然后获取必要的情报。执行经理，你听明白了吗？

<How are we supposed to find this 'target' if you're not even going to tell us who it is...?>
<但我要如何找到一个连身份都不知道的目标……？>

Dante asks if there are any identifying characteristics to this 'target'.
其在询问是否有特定的方法可以识别目标。

I'm sure you'll find out when you get there... You are asking me questions I have no answers to, Dante. Don't waste your time.
去了之后你就知道了……询问我没有的信息是没有用的，但丁。

Well... Off the bus, all.
那么……全员，下车。

I was somewhat wary of the way Vergilius answered me, but... even in murky situations like these, we've always managed to pull through anyway.
虽然维吉里乌斯的回答让人费解……但我们总能在这种情况下找到解决办法。

I'm sure things'll get a little clearer once we get there. I slowly disembarked the bus with the rest of the Sinners.
一定有什么办法，我一边这样想，一边和罪人们一起慢慢地从巴士上下来。
